experiment: h11 prior ranking versus largest test-imported modules
treatment: Existing select.py budget=3, without weight changes
baseline: Top 3 distinct production modules by LOC with at least one original test static import, descending LOC then module name
candidate_to_module: test closure -> module; inheritance -> derived_module; siblings -> alphabetically first module; retain duplicate selections as wasted budget
mutation_budget: 3 AST function-scoped If.test inversions per selected module (when available), deterministic SHA256 sorting, shared mutations for cross-arm overlap
tests: Run original h11 pytest suite for every trial; clean assertion failure=DETECTED; pass=SURVIVED; collection/import errors and nonassertion crashes=INVALID
independent_oracle_bank: Use pre-existing h11 reader/writer wire oracles as a separate positive-control coverage metric; compare how many of those two previously validated modules each arm selects, and never call original tests independent
outcome_caveat: Only the two codec modules have independent oracles; do not call raw test sensitivity a controlled measure of contract value
note: Existing h11 is familiar, so this is a calibration experiment, not a blind independent-repository result
source_safety: All fault injection in temporary worktree, leave master unchanged and source clean
